dimensions.assessment: Affects low-income students, families, pre-kindergarten children, and private schools in the District of Columbia and surrounding metropolitan region.
dimensions.evidence: funds private school scholarships for low-income students in DC... expands the program to include pre-kindergarten students

dimensions.assessment: Modifies scholarship parameters, accreditation timelines, tutoring assistance availability, and administrative board residency requirements.
dimensions.evidence: The term 'Washington metropolitan region' includes the District of Columbia, the counties of Montgomery and Prince Georges in Maryland...

dimensions.assessment: Extends appropriations authorizations through fiscal year 2032 and increases the funding cap for student tutoring services to $2,200,000.
dimensions.evidence: striking '$2,000,000' and inserting '$2,200,000'... striking 'through fiscal year 2023' and inserting 'through fiscal year 2032'

dimensions.assessment: Amends multiple sections of the Scholarships for Opportunity and Results Act regarding grant durations, admissions standards, testing, and reporting.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Scholarships for Opportunity and Results Act to make improvements in the program for awarding school choice scholarships

dimensions.assessment: Extends program authorization and funding provisions through fiscal year 2032.
dimensions.evidence: striking 'through fiscal year 2023' and inserting 'through fiscal year 2032'

missing_information: Total aggregate dollar amounts authorized for the entire scholarship program appropriations are not fully stated outside of fractional allocation descriptions.
importance_detail.rationale: Reauthorizes the DC Opportunity Scholarship Program through fiscal year 2032, expands eligibility to pre-kindergarten, increases tutoring fund caps, and adjusts administrative and evaluation rules.
